title: Field extensions, base change, pullback maps
statement:
Let $k\subseteq k'$ be an extension [def-pc-field-extension] of algebraically closed fields
and let $C$ be a curve over $k$ [def-sc-curves]. Put

$$
\pi_{k'}:C_{k'}:=C\times_kk'\longrightarrow C,
\qquad
F_{k'}:=\pi_{k'}^{-1}F
$$

for an etale sheaf $F$ on $C_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], where $C_{k'}$ is the base change of $C$ along $\operatorname{Spec}k'\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ [def-pc-base-change] and $\pi_{k'}^{-1}$ is the inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and let

$$
\rho^q_{k'/k}(C,F):H^q(C_{\Et},F)\longrightarrow
H^q((C_{k'})_{\Et},F_{k'})
$$

be the pullback map [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback] on etale cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology].
